input.quote: No minimum quantity or purchase commitment applies. Customer pays only for Services ordered in a mutually executed Order Form, and its decision not to enter another Order Form is not a breach or shortfall.
input.rationale: Section 2.1 expressly states that no minimum quantity or purchase commitment applies and that Customer pays only for Services ordered in an executed Order Form, with non-ordering not treated as a breach or shortfall. Section 12.3 reinforces that Customer has made no minimum-volume commitment, and Section 7.1 bars unlisted minimum-use charges. No committed spend, non-reducible seat count, volume cap on Customer usage, or shortfall/take-or-pay mechanic appears in the Order Form (Section 4) or renewal (Section 8) provisions. This sits at the preferred position, so no redline is proposed.
